title: Durgeddin's Forge

location.name: The Foundry
location.description: The industrial heart of Khundrukar — cold forges, quenching pools, ore chutes, and a great central smithy where Durgeddin the Black once hammered out blades of legendary hatred. Gray dwarves (duergar) have since claimed it, relighting a few forges for their own grim work.
location.environment: dungeon, dwarven foundry, forges and flooded galleries

read_aloud: The stair descends into heat and the ring of hammers. This is the Foundry — Durgeddin's great smithy, its forges cold for generations but for a few now relit. Quenching pools steam in the dark; chains and half-finished blades hang from the rafters. The smiths who work here now are no dwarves of honor: gray-skinned, red-eyed duergar, who down tools and reach for weapons the moment your light falls across them.

enemies.position: at the forges and quenching pools
enemies.special: Enlarge before melee; one uses Invisibility to flank the back line. Fight from chokepoints.

encounters.tactics: The duergar Enlarge and hold the forge chokepoints, using the quenching-pool steam for concealment. One turns invisible to ambush casters. They fight to hold the Foundry but will not chase into the flooded gallery (the roper's territory — they know better).
encounters.description: The duergar occupation of the smithy. The flooded gallery to the side hides a roper (see the second encounter) — a lurking trap for the careless.

encounters.trigger_condition: party enters the flooded side gallery to reach the vault stair

enemies.position: disguised as a stalagmite in the flooded gallery (False Appearance)
enemies.special: Grapples with tendrils (reach 50 ft) and reels victims into bite range. Solo lurker.

encounters.tactics: The roper waits motionless until a PC comes within tendril reach, then grapples and reels. Kill the tendrils (AC 20, 10 HP each) or the body (AC 20, 93 HP). It cannot pursue — a party that retreats can choose to avoid it, but the vault stair lies beyond it.
encounters.description: A classic dungeon lurker. Perceptive parties (Perception vs its Stealth +5) may spot the 'stalagmite' that has no twin and avoid or ambush it.

loot.location: a duergar foreman wields a Durgeddin-forged Warhammer +1
the duergar pay-chest by the main forge, Investigation DC 12
a suit hanging in the smithy, unfinished but wearable (heavy armor, superior craft)

skill_checks.success: Spot the roper — the lone 'stalagmite' in the flooded gallery that doesn't match the others.
skill_checks.failure: Walk into tendril range unaware (roper gets surprise).

skill_checks.success: Relight and use a forge to repair a broken weapon or free a stuck mechanism.

dm_notes: SCALING (6 PCs, +50%): 5 duergar (from ~3-4) + the roper as a deadly optional lurker guarding the vault route. The roper is beatable at L4 by 6 optimized PCs but punishing to the careless — reward Perception and ranged focus-fire on tendrils. 3+ interactables: quenching pools (shove for steam/scalding), forge bellows (gout of flame — DEX save), hanging chains (swing/entangle).
